scope: Operator-reported long session plus targeted evidence from HRLTP-T1 and autorun lane-binding R1; not a complete session trace audit

measurements.workedTimeSemantics: Operator-visible Worked total; timer aggregation, precise start/end and inclusion of overlapping agents not independently verified
measurements.operatorReportedQuotaRaw: quota 1 tuan cua Codex / one week of Codex quota
measurements.quotaProvenance: OPERATOR_REPORTED; no before/after usage receipt or attribution to individual tasks/models
measurements.aggregationBoundary: Git elapsed is a different interval and metric from Worked; do not add them or attribute the full session quota to this subtranche

findings.finding: Dispatch omitted the system-chain fingerprint dependency; the worker correctly returned blocked rather than editing outside its manifest
findings.basis: Committed R1 completion, findings and Local amendment sections
findings.lesson: Check dependency closure before delegation; a correct refusal is boundary-control success but still exposes planning cost

findings.finding: Accepted targeted tests and independent probes demonstrate bounded technical value, while the operator rejects the total time/quota tradeoff
findings.basis: Committed test/probe evidence plus operator report
findings.lesson: Track accepted outcome, total elapsed, rework and operator interventions together; gate counts alone are not productivity

findings.finding: Existing review-cost standard explicitly excludes provider-native internal helpers from separately-dispatched external invocation accounting
findings.basis: CVF_REVIEW_COST_AND_DIMINISHING_RETURN_CONTROL_STANDARD.md, Review Dispatch Convergence And Invocation Budget Control
findings.lesson: An internal accounting exemption must not be interpreted as zero resource cost; record a parent-level observable budget even when provider meters are unavailable

findings.finding: Strong models and separate roles did not prevent dispatch omissions or root integration overhead
findings.basis: R1 allocation and dependency repair evidence; no controlled alternate-model experiment
findings.lesson: Increase effort only for a named semantic uncertainty; task decomposition, context quality and verifiable acceptance remain separate requirements

findings.finding: Review independence is bounded: distinct read-only execution and separate fixtures do not provide separate provider, physical machine or organizational authority
findings.basis: R1 completion oracleSeparationBasis and shared-workspace allocation
findings.lesson: Record actor, evidence and runtime isolation separately; changing a model or assigning a role alone does not establish independent review

proposedOwnerChanges.change: Require an observable delegation benefit, disjoint write ownership, dependency readiness, return oracle, parent resource envelope and stop condition
proposedOwnerChanges.acceptanceProbe: Reject a proposed delegation with duplicate ownership, no bounded deliverable or no parent budget; preserve internal implementation autonomy

proposedOwnerChanges.change: Separate parent elapsed/Worked, agent cumulative duration, invocation counts, quota availability, rework and operator intervention telemetry; record internal-helper usage without fabricating unavailable tokens
proposedOwnerChanges.acceptanceProbe: Unknown usage remains unknown, never zero; overlapping durations cannot be summed as wall time; exhausted declared envelope stops further automatic delegation

proposedOwnerChanges.change: Select capability/effort by uncertainty, risk and verifiability rather than permanently binding a model to a role
proposedOwnerChanges.acceptanceProbe: Every escalation states an unresolved uncertainty and a measurable expected gain; routine wiring with a deterministic oracle does not require the strongest tier by default

localOperatingDecision.reviewClaim: SELF_REVIEW_WITH_MACHINE_EVIDENCE; do not label new same-actor work independent
localOperatingDecision.futureDelegationCriterion: Expected reduction in accepted-outcome time/risk must exceed briefing, integration and review overhead
localOperatingDecision.futureBudgetProposal: Declare parent time/invocation envelope before dispatch; reassess at exhaustion or repeated same-root-cause rework, without opening automatic successor tranches
localOperatingDecision.futureComparison: Use a few naturally occurring comparable bounded tasks, record task difficulty and evidence quality, and compare accepted outcomes; no costly replay is authorized by this record

limitations: This observation cannot rank model capability or establish that a cheaper model would have succeeded faster.
No causal single-agent versus multi-agent comparison exists.
Historical fast-path labels and gate success are not evidence that the full operator-reported session met a time budget.
This JSON is a persisted learning candidate, not an activated guard, completed foundation upgrade or automatic P4 sample.
